data.action: 跪坐在戏服箱旁，一手拿剧本，另一手放在腿间
data.camera: medium shot, eye-level with the kneeling subject
data.description: 毕业后的屋顶排练间隙，成年茜跪坐在戏服箱旁，女仆装松开，一手拿着剧本，紫金色晚霞映在屋顶与衣料上。
data.lighting: 绚烂紫金晚霞逆光与金色高光轮廓
data.promptProse: Adult Akane kneels beside costume cases after graduation, holding her marked script while her other hand moves between her legs beneath the opened maid costume. Violet-gold sunset light edges her hair and the fabric against the rooftop.
data.title: 黑川茜 · 晚霞屋顶的排练间隙
data.animaCaption: Her marked script rests in one hand beside the costume cases.
